posting.title: IT Business Services Consultant
posting.job_description:
Job Description
What you’ll do
One of SAP’s strategic customers has conducted a transformation program, part of which is to consume their entire SAP landscape as enhanced private cloud model provided by SAP with more than 80 productive systems and several of the largest SAP HANA-based systems. To provide the right level of service, a dedicated team has been set up within SAP Enterprise Cloud Services to work for this strategic client. The goal of this team is to operate the entire customer SAP landscape and drive innovation adoption as the customer is at the start of a large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
Key Responsibilities:
Deep understanding of customer landscape from technical and business perspectives including its interfaces
Strong collaboration with the customer for planning and operations
Align on upcoming changes with the Release Management and plan the execution accordingly
Ensure high availability of customer service by supporting service restoration in critical situations and working proactively on the stability of the landscape
Analyse and deep dive into issues including the creation of RCAs as the foundation for continuous improvement
Support productization of services including, if required initial setup, documentation, and standardization
Align on planning activities and system build processes, define Handover criteria, and ensure operational readiness of the Operations team as a pre-condition for any customer GoLive
Where you belong:
Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS) is part of the Customer Value Group board area, sitting within Global Cloud Operations (GCO), an organization dedicated to delivering exceptional end-to-end operational experiences and seamless technical adoption for customers throughout their cloud journey.
ECS is the delivery organization responsible for running and operating SAP's Cloud ERP Private offering (RISE with SAP). We provide technical managed services and operations across the full stack, helping thousands of customers worldwide become intelligent enterprises. Our teams operate across all major regions - EMEA, MEE, AMER, and APAC, bringing strong international focus and rich cultural diversity to everything we do.
Within ECS, the MEE Large Customer Operations (LCO) team takes accountability for a select group of high-complexity customers, operating them in a ring-fenced model to meet the highest standards of operational excellence. Together, we cultivate a culture built on deep technical ownership, proactive governance, and strategic advisory, empowering customers to achieve their business outcomes and succeed in their SAP transformation journeys.
Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement
Our company does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, Mathematics or comparable
Background in SAP technology and products with excellent knowledge in SAP NetWeaver Administration and Operations and cross-dependencies like integration
Knowledge of the whole technology stack (Application, Database, Server management) and the ability to assess issues and system architectures
Experience in operation of systems installations is a must
Ability to own and coordinate operational tasks, customer escalations, process improvements
Competency to take critical decisions and working under high pressure
Be a team player and able to inspire and energize team with strong technical, verbal and written communication skills
Flexibility to work on weekends/off hours during critical customer escalations, cut-overs or go-lives.
9 - 13+ years of experience as SAP Basis consultant / System Admin or in a similar role
Fluent in English language is a must, German language skills are beneficial
Additional Information
About SAP
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.
We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy and childbirth), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.
Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.
AI Usage in the Recruitment Process
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

posting.job_description:
Job Description
SAP iXp Intern Business Transformation Intern
What You'll Build
The SAP Internship Experience Program is SAPs global, strategic, internship program that provides university students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers. This is more than an internship; its the foundation for a career built on bond, creativity, and impact.
Position title: SAP iXp Intern Business Transformation Intern
Location: Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
As a Business Transformation Intern, you will support global transformation initiatives within the Adoption and Consumption Practices & Platform team. Working closely with your project lead, you will help evaluate business challenges, improve existing ways of working, and design scalable processes and solutions across multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
Your responsibilities will include analyzing current processes, identifying pain points and opportunities for simplification, standardization, and automation, and helping translate these into future-state processes, frameworks, playbooks, and more.
Data and reporting will be an important part of the role. You will work with business and operational data to track key metrics, identify trends, and generate insights that support decision-making. This may include consolidating and analyzing data, developing reports and dashboards, and translating findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
You will also support transformation initiatives from design through execution by gathering business requirements, coordinating stakeholders, and contributing to field readiness through enablement and communications.
Through this work, you will gain exposure to large-scale global programs spanning multiple functions and regions and learn how transformation initiatives are analyzed, designed, implemented, and measured within a global organization. You will collaborate with stakeholders across functions and time zones while receiving regular guidance and mentorship from your manager and project leads.
What You'll Bring
We are looking for someone who makes effort, perseveres, and stays curious. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning.
Educational & Experience Requirements
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Information Systems, Data/Business Analytics, Economics, or a related field (preferably in 2nd year or 3rd year)
Available to work full-time for the full 6-month internship duration
Exposure to business transformation, process improvement, data analysis, operations, or project work is an advantage
Technical and Functional Skills
Deep written and verbal English communication skills
Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex or ambiguous topics
Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets, including organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data to identify trends and insights
Ability to translate analysis into clear presentations, reports, and recommendations
Awareness with process mapping, project management, reporting, or dashboarding is an advantage
Comfortable using common productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation tools, documents)
This role is designed for a motivated intern with strong foundational skills rather than deep prior experience. Training, guidance, and mentorship will be provided. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, adaptability, and initiative over perfect technical proficiency, and encourage candidates who meet most but not necessarily all of the requirements to apply.
Where You Belong
Be part of SAP Next Gen, a global community for students, universities, schools and educational partners, who are passionate about innovation and technology.
Culture of Collaboration: Partner with experienced SAP colleagues and expert mentors who will support your growth. Grow professionally through personalized mentoring, coaching, and career development support.
Project-driven Experience: Kickstart your career with hands-on learning experience, making an impact from day one by contributing to meaningful projects that help the world run better. Youll have endless learning resources at your fingertips and gain future-ready skills from a variety of virtual, in-person, and hybrid learning sessions, cultivated just for you, and aligned with our learning approach.
Gain Visibility: Build relationships with leaders and peers across teams and functions. Showcase your ideas, skills, and creativity in a global, fast-paced environment. Open doors for future career opportunities within SAP and beyond.
Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

posting.title: UI Developer
posting.job_description:
Job Description
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and product-minded UI Developer to join the CX One OMS UI, SAP's unified back-office interface for Order Management Services. The UI brings co-operatively multiple OMS applications into one coherent experience, helping enterprise customers manage their order operations across channels and fulfilment networks.
This means you will not be starting from scratch: you will be inheriting a working codebase, contributing to its technical quality and completeness, and helping deliver something stable and polished to market. You'll work in a team of engineers in a collaborative, agile environment where delivery discipline and technical craftsmanship go hand in hand.
You will help the team use effective AI-assisted development practices. You will use new tools and workflows. The goal is to improve productivity. We also want to maintain software quality, security, and maintainability. This will drive customer impact.
What You'll Do
You'll design, develop, and maintain production-grade AI-enabled features and services, with a focus on scalability and reliability. LLM integration and basic RAG workflows, including prompt management and response validation, are part of your core work. You'll build and improve evaluation and benchmarking pipelines to measure AI output quality and system performance. Application health, latency, throughput, and system efficiency are areas you'll actively monitor and improve. Debugging and resolving production issues, contributing to incident analysis, and implementing stability fixes are all expected. You'll support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. Cross-functional collaboration to refine requirements and improve system design is a regular expectation.
Build, refine, and harden features in a production-grade React / TypeScript frontend that serves enterprise customers managing complex order management operations
Apply the SAP Design System consistently, using an enterprise UI component library as the underlying toolkit
Translate Figma designs and UX specifications into user interfaces that are precise, accessible, and responsive. Identify any design ambiguities and technical limitations early while collaborating with UX designers and product owners.
Implement and maintain REST API integrations with robust error handling, loading state management, and consistent data patterns
Write unit, component, and integration tests (Vitest, React Testing Library) and contribute to E2E test coverage (Playwright)
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and the reliability of build and deployment automation
Participate actively in code reviews, giving and receiving constructive, specific feedback
Use AI-assisted development tools every day. This includes tasks such as implementing, refactoring, generating tests, and creating documentation. Always review and validate any AI-generated results before accepting them.
Contribute to production monitoring and troubleshooting. Use telemetry, browser error tracking, and user feedback to identify, diagnose, and resolve issues in production
Support technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team
What You Bring
You have robust coding and debugging skills and hands-on experience building and operating cloud-based microservices. A solid awareness of APIs, distributed systems basics, and CI/CD practices is required. Experience with AI/LLM workflows, including prompt design, basic RAG patterns, and integrating AI services into applications, is important. Knowledge with observability (logging, metrics, tracing), performance tuning, and system monitoring is expected. An ownership mindset, combined with experience in testing, validation, and troubleshooting production systems, will set you up to contribute well.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent functional experience
Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience, with meaningful recent frontend experience
Strong TypeScript proficiency - comfortable with types, generics, type narrowing, async patterns, and working in a fully typed codebase
Solid production experience with React. This includes working with functional components and hooks. It involves component composition, managing state, and developing with a focus on performance.
Robust experience with an enterprise UI component library - component usage, customization, and theme integration with a design system
Solid grasp of HTML, CSS, and browser fundamentals including accessibility semantics, responsive design, and cross-browser behavior
Knowledge with design systems and design tokens
Knowledge with modern frontend build tooling (Vite or similar), package management, and code quality tooling (ESLint, Prettier)
Knowledge with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tooling (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar) - comfortable navigating and contributing to build and deployment workflows
Security fundamentals include authentication and authorization methods like JWT, OAuth2, and OIDC. Knowledge of input validation is also important. You should be aware of the OWASP Top 10.
Comfortable writing unit and component tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Vitest, or similar) and E2E tests (Playwright, Cypress, or similar)
Proficient with Git and collaborative development workflows
Genuine, practiced experience using AI coding assistants and agents (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your development workflow, beyond the use of autocomplete. Able to decompose tasks for AI execution, write effective specifications with the right context and constraints, and critically review AI-generated code with the same rigour as any other contribution
Nice to Have
Knowledge with the SAP Design System, SAP Fiori, or the SAP Horizon theme
Experience with Storybook or similar tools for component documentation and design system consumption
Knowledge with RTK Query
Experience with accessibility auditing tools (a11y, Lighthouse, or similar)
Knowledge of SAP infrastructure platforms (BTP, Kyma) or cloud platforms (Azure)
Knowledge with OMS domain concepts (order capture, fulfilment, inventory, returns)
Contributions to open-source projects
How You Work
You'll own features and modules end-to-end and work closely with product, data, platform, and AI teams to align on goals and deliver quality results. This team values direct communication, shared accountability, and continuous improvement. You'll participate in code reviews, share technical knowledge, and help build team capabilities as you develop deeper expertise in AI-native application development.
We value the skills you bring and support you to build on them through our learning and development opportunities. These are the skills associated with this role:
You take ownership of what you build: correctness, accessibility, performance, and production behaviour
You review AI-generated output critically. You understand it is untrusted input until validated through tests, static analysis, and careful reading
You are proactive on clarifying ambiguous requirements
You are comfortable inheriting an existing codebase and improving it incrementally
You are a continuous learner, particularly in the fast-moving space of AI-assisted development, where practices are evolving quickly
You collaborate openly, give honest code review feedback, and receive it constructively
You value user experience and functional correctness
